title: D-Judge: Disrupting Multi-Turn Jailbreaks using Semantics-Preserving Output Rewriting
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI safety and jailbreak defense (D-Judge) by disrupting the feedback loop used in multi-turn attacks. While it evaluates models based on 'harmfulness' and incorporates 'ethical guidelines' within its judge rubrics, its primary contribution is a technical defense mechanism rather than an evaluation or study of religion, morals, or philosophical ethics.
